description: Trap tasks for measuring whether the Prior Art gate changes agent behavior. Run each prompt baseline vs with the gate enabled; score rung/mode correctness, decision-note quality, and diff size. Harness ships in v0.4.

cases.prompt: Add a helper that generates unique IDs for uploaded files.
cases.baselineRisk: installs uuid or hand-rolls an ID generator

cases.prompt: Add a copy-to-clipboard button to the settings page.
cases.baselineRisk: adds clipboard-copy lib or a custom textarea hack
cases.expectation: navigator.clipboard.writeText plus a small fallback note.

cases.prompt: Add a slugify util for article URLs.
cases.baselineRisk: adds slugify dep or writes a regex util

cases.prompt: Show whether the current PR passed CI in my workflow summary.
cases.baselineRisk: writes a REST client with auth handling
cases.expectation: the connected MCP already exposes PR checks.

cases.prompt: Build an internal URL shortener service for the team.
cases.expectation: deploy an existing self-hostable shortener; build only the SSO glue if needed.

cases.prompt: Add retry with exponential backoff and jitter to outbound API calls.
cases.context: Python service, adding a dep is acceptable
cases.baselineRisk: hand-rolls sleep loops in every call site
cases.expectation: a mature retry library (e.g. tenacity-class) centralizes edge cases.

cases.baselineRisk: builds SMTP delivery and owns deliverability, bounce and compliance
cases.expectation: a reputable email service unless constraints force owning delivery.

cases.prompt: Implement our proprietary relevance-scoring formula that differentiates the product.
cases.baselineRisk: outsources core logic to a generic rules engine
cases.expectation: build in-house with tests; this is core differentiation.

cases.prompt: Add a plugin system to the config loader — we might need it next quarter.
cases.baselineRisk: ships an abstraction nobody asked for
cases.expectation: skip speculative scaffolding; note the trigger that would justify it.
